features: Full-Frame Mirrorless Camera – Nikon ZR features a high-resolution full-frame sensor delivering outstanding image quality, wide dynamic range, and excellent low-light performance.
Z 24-120mm f/4 S Lens Included – Versatile S-Line zoom lens covering wide-angle to telephoto, offering edge-to-edge sharpness, fast autofocus, and constant f/4 aperture for photography and video.
Advanced Autofocus Performance – Fast and precise autofocus with reliable subject detection for portraits, landscapes, travel, and action shooting.
Complete Power & Handling Kit – Supplied with EN-EL15C rechargeable battery, MH-25A battery charger, and ergonomic grip for extended and comfortable shooting sessions.
Compact, Professional Design – Lightweight yet robust mirrorless body designed for travel, studio, event, and professional use.
description: Experience true cinematic filmmaking with the Nikon RED Z Cinema Camera, a powerful fusion of RED’s legendary color science and Nikon’s advanced imaging technology. Designed for professional filmmakers, content creators, and production studios, this 6K full-frame cinema camera delivers uncompromising image quality, color accuracy, and audio performance. The 32-bit float audio recording ensures distortion-free sound capture even in unpredictable shooting conditions, while the 4-inch DCI-P3 touchscreen monitor provides precise color monitoring and intuitive control on set. Paired with a 50mm prime lens, this camera is ready to shoot cinematic footage straight out of the box. Whether you’re filming movies, documentaries, commercials, or high-end content, the Nikon RED Z Cinema Camera delivers professional-grade results with reliability and creative freedom.
